effect.summary: A nascent ka stone prevents dying from worsening on a failed recovery check and limits worsening on a critical failure.

golarion.power.fortified-flesh.name: FORTIFIED FLESH

golarion.power.attunement-to-stone.name: ATTUNEMENT TO STONE

golarion.power.attunement-to-stone.combines: Ka stone activation casts meld into stone.

golarion.power.stone-communion.name: STONE COMMUNION

golarion.power.red-mantis-assassin-dedic.name: RED MANTIS ASSASSIN DEDICATION

golarion.power.advanced-red-mantis-magic.who_may: Red Mantis spellcasters with the prerequisite feat.
golarion.power.advanced-red-mantis-magic.combines: Uses the Red Mantis assassin spellbook.
golarion.power.advanced-red-mantis-magic.blocked_reason: The spell-slot and spellbook progression requires a spellcasting subsystem.

golarion.power.crimson-shroud.name: CRIMSON SHROUD

golarion.power.crimson-shroud.who_may: Characters with Red Mantis Assassin Dedication.
golarion.power.crimson-shroud.combines: Interacting with the veil grants a temporary AC bonus.
golarion.power.crimson-shroud.blocked_reason: The death-triggered body disappearance is not described by the basic effect grammar and its after-death status is unspecified.

golarion.power.mantis-form.name: MANTIS FORM

effect.summary: For one minute, transforms the caster into a mantis using insect-form effects.

golarion.power.mantis-form.who_may: A character who has gained the focus spell.
golarion.power.mantis-form.combines: Uses insect form effects heightened to this spell’s level.
golarion.power.mantis-form.blocked_reason: The spell changes the user’s body into another form.

golarion.rule.sun-orchid-elixir-sale-res.go_wrong: Pharasma’s wrath is feared if Thuvians buy it.
golarion.rule.sun-orchid-elixir-sale-res.combines: The selling city-state rotates annually among five cities.

golarion.rule.ka-stone-investiture-and-r.name: Ka stone investiture and removal

effect.summary: The ka stone is invested automatically each day, cannot be dispelled or removed without permission, and cannot lose investiture.

golarion.rule.ka-stone-investiture-and-r.go_wrong: No loss of investiture is possible.
golarion.rule.ka-stone-investiture-and-r.combines: The stone grants a scaling bonus to saves against death and negative effects.
golarion.rule.ka-stone-investiture-and-r.blocked_reason: The rule defines persistent investiture and removal restrictions not covered by the basic effect grammar.

golarion.rule.black-pearl-aeon-stone-bre.name: Black pearl aeon stone breakage

effect.summary: Each activation risks destroying the stone and permanently ending its magic.

golarion.rule.black-pearl-aeon-stone-bre.cost_or_limit: DC 5 flat check after each activation.
golarion.rule.black-pearl-aeon-stone-bre.blocked_reason: The rule models permanent destruction and loss of an item’s magical properties.

golarion.rule.hermean-assessment-exile.name: Hermean Assessment exile

effect.summary: At age sixteen, children judged below Mengkare’s standard of potential are banished to the mainland and cannot return.

golarion.rule.hermean-assessment-exile.cost_or_limit: Assessment occurs at age sixteen; exile is permanent.
golarion.rule.hermean-assessment-exile.go_wrong: Reasons can include ordinary ability, illness, impairment, or disruptive behavior.
golarion.rule.hermean-assessment-exile.combines: The decision may be unexplained to the child and family.

golarion.rule.jellyfish-lamp-survival.name: Jellyfish lamp survival

effect.summary: The living lamp dies after more than one hour out of water and can usually live a year when maintained in seawater with nutrients.

golarion.rule.jellyfish-lamp-survival.cost_or_limit: One hour out of water; usual maximum lifespan of one year.
golarion.rule.jellyfish-lamp-survival.go_wrong: The jellyfish dries up and dies.
golarion.rule.jellyfish-lamp-survival.combines: Good care may produce stronger light or additional abilities.

golarion.rule.dead-magic-in-alkenstar-s-.name: Dead magic in Alkenstar’s region

effect.summary: Warped radiation prevents magic from functioning in parts of the region.

golarion.rule.dead-magic-in-alkenstar-s-.cost_or_limit: Applies to affected areas, especially the western Mana Wastes.
golarion.rule.dead-magic-in-alkenstar-s-.who_may: Magic users and magical effects in the affected region.
golarion.rule.dead-magic-in-alkenstar-s-.where_from: The arcane wars between Nex and Geb.
golarion.rule.dead-magic-in-alkenstar-s-.blocked_reason: The effect suppresses magic across a region rather than targeting a single working.

golarion.rule.dead-laws.name: Dead Laws

effect.summary: Geb’s laws regulate feeding, restrict some necromancy, forbid positive-energy channeling, and set standards for slaves’ treatment.

golarion.rule.dead-laws.cost_or_limit: The protections nominally cover the living Quick and intelligent undead; some nobles defy them.
golarion.rule.dead-laws.go_wrong: Violations may bring legal prosecution or permanent death.
golarion.rule.dead-laws.who_may: Geb’s citizens and authorities; protections apply to mortals and intelligent undead.
golarion.rule.dead-laws.combines: Governs the treatment and maintenance of living and undead slaves.
golarion.rule.dead-laws.blocked_reason: The passage describes several legal prohibitions and enforcement consequences, not a single basic effect.

golarion.rule.reanimation-of-mortals-who.name: Reanimation of mortals who die in Geb

effect.summary: Unless an exception is specified, mortals dying on Geb’s soil rise as mindless undead slaves.

golarion.rule.reanimation-of-mortals-who.cost_or_limit: Applies by royal decree to mortals who die within Geb unless otherwise specified.
golarion.rule.reanimation-of-mortals-who.go_wrong: The result is mindless undeath and enslavement.
golarion.rule.reanimation-of-mortals-who.who_may: Mortals who die on Geb’s soil.
golarion.rule.reanimation-of-mortals-who.combines: Some visitors arrange to become intelligent undead instead.
golarion.rule.reanimation-of-mortals-who.blocked_reason: Death, continued existence, and postmortem mind state require a soul-state capability.

golarion.rule.challenge-of-sky-and-heave.name: Challenge of Sky and Heaven

effect.summary: A decade-based tournament where the Houses compete in several disciplines.

golarion.rule.challenge-of-sky-and-heave.mind: Competitions include mastery of the self and esoteric disciplines.
golarion.rule.challenge-of-sky-and-heave.who_may: Students of the Houses of Perfection.
golarion.rule.challenge-of-sky-and-heave.combines: Includes historical knowledge, swordplay, unarmed fighting, and arcane ability.
golarion.rule.challenge-of-sky-and-heave.blocked_reason: This is a described contest, not a supernatural effect.

golarion.rule.punishment-of-seven-angry-.name: Punishment of Seven Angry Suns

effect.summary: Walkena sentences people who question him to a horrific, fatal punishment.

golarion.rule.punishment-of-seven-angry-.cost_or_limit: Applied to those who question Walkena.
golarion.rule.punishment-of-seven-angry-.blocked_reason: The passage states that the punishment is fatal but does not specify its procedure.

golarion.rule.osibu-visitor-departure-co.name: Osibu visitor departure condition

effect.summary: Visitors cannot leave Osibu unless they accept a location-secrecy geas or take a concoction that erases their memory of the city.

golarion.rule.osibu-visitor-departure-co.cost_or_limit: Every visitor must accept one of the two conditions before leaving.
golarion.rule.osibu-visitor-departure-co.mind: One option removes memory of Osibu's location.
golarion.rule.osibu-visitor-departure-co.who_may: Osibu's visitors are subject to the condition.
golarion.rule.osibu-visitor-departure-co.combines: The geas binds secrecy; the alternative is a memory-erasing concoction.
golarion.rule.osibu-visitor-departure-co.blocked_reason: The rule relies on a binding geas or memory removal, neither of which is supported by the basic effect grammar.

golarion.rule.eye-of-abendego-permanence.name: Eye of Abendego permanence

effect.summary: The Eye of Abendego is a permanent hurricane that continues to affect the region.

golarion.rule.eye-of-abendego-permanence.go_wrong: Its flooding devastated Lirgen and Yamasa.
golarion.rule.eye-of-abendego-permanence.blocked_reason: An enduring, region-scale hurricane requires a persistent area effect.

golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.name: Infernal contracts

effect.summary: A signed infernal contract binds the signer to its benefit and payment, usually their soul.

golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.cost_or_limit: Must be signed in duplicate; terms become irrevocable once signed, and the contract overrides other magical effects or immunities.
golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.go_wrong: The signer may lose their soul as payment.
golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.who_may: Devils use them to bargain with mortals, chiefly good- and neutral-aligned people.
golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.combines: Can be undone only by destroying both copies, or under other specific contract circumstances.
golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.mechanism: Binding magical agreement and soul payment
golarion.rule.infernal-contracts.blocked_reason: Soul capture and an overriding, conditionally breakable magical bond are not represented by the basic effect grammar.

golarion.rule.runelord-shelters.name: Runelord shelters

effect.summary: The runelords escaped death from Earthfall but remained locked away for millennia, neither alive nor dead.

golarion.rule.runelord-shelters.cost_or_limit: Their shelters did not allow them to emerge as they expected.
golarion.rule.runelord-shelters.go_wrong: They remained sealed away for ages.
golarion.rule.runelord-shelters.where_from: Each runelord devised an individual solution.
golarion.rule.runelord-shelters.blocked_reason: The neither-alive-nor-dead state is beyond the basic effect grammar.

golarion.rule.irrisen-s-eternal-winter.name: Irrisen’s eternal winter

effect.summary: Winter remains constant in Irrisen even Baba Yaga cannot or will not end it.

golarion.rule.irrisen-s-eternal-winter.where_from: Baba Yaga’s conquest and the nation’s founding.
golarion.rule.irrisen-s-eternal-winter.blocked_reason: A permanent region-wide climate effect needs an area-field mechanism.

golarion.rule.irrisen-queens-succession.name: Irrisen queens’ succession

effect.summary: Every century Baba Yaga took the reigning daughter away and installed another daughter.

golarion.rule.irrisen-queens-succession.cost_or_limit: Typically repeated at 100-year intervals; Elvanna’s reign broke the pattern.
golarion.rule.irrisen-queens-succession.go_wrong: Elvanna captured Baba Yaga and disrupted the succession.
golarion.rule.irrisen-queens-succession.combines: Baba Yaga promised each ruling daughter eternal youth.
golarion.rule.irrisen-queens-succession.blocked_reason: This is a narrative succession rule rather than an effect requiring the basic grammar.

golarion.rule.linnorm-kings-right-to-rul.name: Linnorm Kings’ right to rule

effect.summary: A claimant must seek, confront, and defeat a linnorm to rightfully rule.

golarion.rule.linnorm-kings-right-to-rul.cost_or_limit: A linnorm must be defeated in combat.
golarion.rule.linnorm-kings-right-to-rul.go_wrong: A slain linnorm can curse its killer.
golarion.rule.linnorm-kings-right-to-rul.combines: May result in recruiting the defeated linnorm instead of killing it.
golarion.rule.linnorm-kings-right-to-rul.blocked_reason: A qualification condition is directly usable as a game rule.

golarion.rule.elven-aiudara-travel.name: Elven aiudara travel

effect.summary: Magical elf gates allow travel to distant lands.

golarion.rule.elven-aiudara-travel.combines: Powered by the Sovyrian Stone, according to p128.

golarion.rule.final-blade-soul-trapping.name: Final blade soul trapping

effect.summary: A soul executed by a final blade remains trapped and cannot be returned to life until released.

golarion.rule.final-blade-soul-trapping.cost_or_limit: A blade can hold any number of souls.
golarion.rule.final-blade-soul-trapping.who_may: Only a complex ritual known to the Gray Gardeners or destruction of the blade releases souls.
golarion.rule.final-blade-soul-trapping.blocked_reason: The rule governs trapped souls and prevents restoration to life.

golarion.rule.final-blade-invulnerabilit.name: Final blade invulnerability

effect.summary: A final blade cannot be damaged except by a specific means.

golarion.rule.final-blade-invulnerabilit.cost_or_limit: Only a particular, unspecified means can harm it.
golarion.rule.final-blade-invulnerabilit.combines: A rumored ritual may destroy the blades.
golarion.rule.final-blade-invulnerabilit.blocked_reason: The specific means of destruction is not provided.

golarion.rule.sovyrian-stone-powers-aiud.name: Sovyrian Stone powers aiudara

effect.summary: The Sovyrian Stone supplies the power that operates all aiudara.

golarion.rule.sovyrian-stone-powers-aiud.go_wrong: Its corruption might create a permanent Abyssal portal.
golarion.rule.sovyrian-stone-powers-aiud.blocked_reason: The passage describes an item that powers other items without a defined basic-grammar mechanism.
